u0: The agent starts in the central corridor with nothing accomplished yet: the key has not been located, it is not carrying the matching key, the locked door is shut, the target room has not been entered, and the ball has not been picked up. The full sequence still lies ahead: find the key, pick it up, use it to open the locked door, step into the target room, and pick up the ball there. Acting out of order before the key is found — entering the target room, opening the door, or picking up the ball — ends the attempt in failure.
u1: A required ordering has been broken before the key was even located, so the mission can no longer be completed. This happens if the agent enters the target room, opens the locked door, or picks up the ball without first having found the key. The task is failed.
u2: The matching key has been located, satisfying the requirement that it be found, and the agent is not yet carrying it. It still needs to pick the key up, then open the locked door, enter the target room, and pick up the ball. Until it is holding the key, reaching the target room or opening the door would still fail the attempt.
u3: The key has been located and the agent is now carrying it, so the key is secured. Next it must open the locked door, then go through into the target room and pick up the ball. Care is needed: the key must eventually be dropped before the ball can be taken, and entering the target room without the door being open would fail the attempt.
u4: The key has been found and carried, and the locked door has been opened with it. The agent still needs to step through into the target room and pick up the ball. The door remains open unless it is deliberately shut again, and the key will need to be dropped before the ball can be picked up.
u5: The key has been found and carried, the locked door has been opened, and the agent has entered the target room. All that remains is to pick up the mission's ball, which requires free hands, so the key must have been dropped or otherwise set down first. Picking up the ball completes the mission.
u6: The mission's ball has been picked up after the key was found, the locked door was opened, and the target room was entered. All requirements have been satisfied and the task is complete.
